description: Add both style and function to your nursery with the Newport Nightstand. Crafted from solid hardwood with a rich Brown Maple finish, this compact nightstand provides the perfect spot for a lamp, a book, or a glass of water beside the glider. Drawer storage keeps pacifiers, burp cloths, and other essentials organized and close at hand. The timeless silhouette complements the full Newport collection, making it a versatile piece that transitions easily from nursery to any room in the home. Non-toxic baby-safe finish.
